COOKIE_MODAL.TITLE: Cookies
COOKIE_MODAL.DESCRIPTION: We use cookies that are essential for the service to work. With your consent, we also use analytics and/or marketing cookies.

COOKIE_POLICY.P1: This cookie policy explains how izyGlam SAS ("izyGlam", "we", "our") uses cookies and similar technologies when you access or use the izyGlam platform, including our website and associated digital services (the “Platform”).
COOKIE_POLICY.P2: We are committed to transparency, data protection, and compliance with applicable privacy regulations, including the General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Article 82 of the French Data Protection Act (Loi Informatique et Libertés).
COOKIE_POLICY.S1_P1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website or use an application. They can help recognize your device, remember preferences, secure sessions, and collect statistical information.
COOKIE_POLICY.S1_P2: Cookies may be set by izyGlam (“first-party” cookies) or by partners (“third-party” cookies).
COOKIE_POLICY.S2_1_P1: These cookies are essential for the operation and security of the Platform. They enable key features such as authentication, fraud prevention, securing payment flows, and account management.
COOKIE_POLICY.S2_1_P2: These cookies cannot be disabled because they are necessary for the service to function properly.
COOKIE_POLICY.S2_2_P1: With your consent, we use audience measurement technologies to understand how the Platform is used and to improve the experience, performance, and product development.
COOKIE_POLICY.S2_3_P1: With your consent, we may use marketing cookies to measure campaign effectiveness, prevent advertising fraud, and provide more relevant communications.
COOKIE_POLICY.S3_P1: Strictly necessary cookies are processed based on our legitimate interest in providing a secure and functional service.
COOKIE_POLICY.S3_P2: Analytics and marketing cookies are processed only based on your prior consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
COOKIE_POLICY.S4_L1: Consent preferences: stored for a maximum of 6 months.
COOKIE_POLICY.S4_L2: Analytics cookies: maximum lifespan of 13 months.
COOKIE_POLICY.S4_L3: Retention of audience data: up to 25 months in aggregated form.
COOKIE_POLICY.S4_L4: Session cookies: deleted upon logout or when the browser is closed.
COOKIE_POLICY.S5_P1: Some analytics or advertising providers may process data outside the European Union. Where applicable, these transfers are governed by appropriate safeguards, including Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission.
COOKIE_POLICY.S6_P1: In accordance with applicable regulations, you have the following rights in particular:
COOKIE_POLICY.S6_L4: Object to processing in certain cases
COOKIE_POLICY.S6_L5: Withdraw your consent at any time and file a complaint with the CNIL
COOKIE_POLICY.S6_P2: You can change your cookie preferences at any time via the “Manage my cookies” interface.

HOMEPAGE.PART1TITLE: Your craft first. Everything else, automated.
HOMEPAGE.PART1TEXT: Your value is your expertise. Calls, bookings, and payments should never pull you away from it. With izyPhone, your automated order-taking assistant, everything is handled for you—even during appointments or while you're on the move. You do what you do best. izyGlam takes care of the rest.
HOMEPAGE.PART2TITLE: Mental load shouldn’t be part of your job.
HOMEPAGE.PART2TEXT: Answering calls, organizing appointments, handling payments, all while working: that mental load weighs on you every day. izyGlam takes that weight off your shoulders. With izyPhone, you get a dedicated number you can use everywhere—social networks, Google, your website—without being disturbed constantly. Calls are answered and appointments confirmed automatically, even when you’re busy. You live more peacefully while maximizing your chances of filling your calendar. Less pressure. More clarity. More freedom.
HOMEPAGE.PART3TEXT: Glam for Business is a platform dedicated to companies of all sizes, designed to manage the beauty needs of your clients and employees. Offer personalized beauty treatments directly at the workplace, during corporate events, or for special occasions. Our qualified professionals travel to deliver services tailored to your needs.

IZYPHONE_STEPS.TITLE: How does izyPhone simplify your daily life?

STEP1.TITLE: You set up your business
STEP1.TEXT: You define your services, availability, and rules once. izyPhone adapts to the way you work—no complexity, no technical settings. In just a few minutes, everything is ready.

STEP2.TITLE: izyPhone takes bookings for you
STEP2.TEXT: Calls, messages, appointment requests, payments. izyPhone answers, schedules, and confirms automatically—even when you’re in a service or unavailable.

STEP3.TITLE: You live and work more peacefully
STEP3.TEXT: While izyPhone handles the rest, you focus on your craft, your clients… and your personal life. Less stress, more clarity, more time for you.

IZYPHONE_MIDDLE_STEPS.TITLE: Why izyGlam truly changes the game

STEP1.TITLE: Protect your privacy (and your clients’)
STEP1.TEXT: Your phone number is no longer exposed everywhere. With izyPhone, calls go through a dedicated assistant without revealing your personal contact details. You protect your privacy, set clear boundaries, and work without being constantly disturbed.

STEP2.TITLE: Stop losing revenue
STEP2.TEXT: A missed call often means a lost service. izyPhone answers automatically, takes bookings, and confirms appointments—even when you’re busy or unavailable. Your business keeps generating revenue without depending on your availability.

STEP3.TITLE: Reduce your mental load every day
STEP3.TEXT: Replying, calling back, scheduling, taking payments… while working. This mental load becomes heavy. With izyPhone, bookings happen automatically and quietly—leading to smoother days and calmer evenings.

STEP1.TITLE: Your business shouldn’t take over your private life
STEP1.TEXT: Your phone rings even at night. Your clients have your personal number. You reply “quickly” all the time. With izyPhone, you finally set clear boundaries. Your number stays private, calls go through your assistant, and your business stops when you decide.

STEP2.TITLE: Every missed call is lost revenue
STEP2.TEXT: When you’re with a client, you can’t answer. When you call back, it’s often too late. izyPhone lets no opportunity slip away. Calls are handled, appointments confirmed, payments secured—even when you’re busy.

STEP3.TITLE: You didn’t start your business to live under pressure
STEP3.TEXT: Managing calls, messages, appointments, payments… Everything relies on you. All the time. izyGlam removes that mental load. With izyPhone, bookings become automatic and silent. You work more peacefully and get home with a lighter mind.

DECLARATION.TITLE: Accessibility statement
DECLARATION.TEXT: izyGlam is committed to making its services accessible to as many people as possible. Our goal is to reach WCAG 2.2 AA compliance and align with the French RGAA, as much as possible.

SCOPE.TITLE: Scope covered
SCOPE.L2: Web app (dashboard) for clients and professionals.

STATUS.TITLE: Compliance status
STATUS.TEXT: As of this statement, izyGlam interfaces are partially compliant with WCAG 2.2 AA / RGAA. We continuously improve our interfaces and fix priority gaps.

PREPARATION.TITLE: How this statement was prepared
PREPARATION.L1: Self-assessments by the product/UI team: HTML semantics review, ARIA roles, tab order.
PREPARATION.L2: Manual testing: keyboard navigation, visible focus, 200%+ zoom, screen readers.
PREPARATION.L3: Tool-assisted testing (automated audits on sample screens).
PREPARATION.L4: Continuous QA during updates (Design System, reusable accessible components).

KEYBOARD.TITLE: Keyboard navigation
KEYBOARD.L1: Full keyboard journey (Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, Esc, arrows).
KEYBOARD.L3: "Skip to content" links to bypass the header.
KEYBOARD.L4: Menus, modals, and dropdowns operable via keyboard (open/close, managed focus trap, close with Esc).

SCREENREADERS.TITLE: Screen readers and structure
SCREENREADERS.L1: Semantic structure with hierarchical headings (h1→h6) and landmarks (header, nav, main, footer).
SCREENREADERS.L2: Clear labels for all fields and buttons, consistent accessible names.
SCREENREADERS.L3: State changes announced via aria-live regions (errors, success, loading).
SCREENREADERS.L4: Informative images include descriptive alt text; decorative images are ignored.

CONTRAST.TITLE: Contrast, colors, and scaling
CONTRAST.L1: Target contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for normal text and ≥ 3:1 for large text.
CONTRAST.L2: Interface usable up to 200% zoom without losing content or functionality.
CONTRAST.L3: No information conveyed by color alone.

FORMS.TITLE: Forms and error messages
FORMS.L2: Errors shown near the field and summarized when needed.
FORMS.L3: Focus moved to the first invalid field with correction guidance.

DYNAMIC.TITLE: Dynamic content and animations
DYNAMIC.L1: Carousels/animated elements are pausable and non-blocking.
DYNAMIC.L2: Respects the system preference for reduced motion where possible.
DYNAMIC.L3: Non-intrusive modals, closable via keyboard and outside click.

MEDIA.TITLE: Media
MEDIA.L1: Videos (where applicable) with captions and/or transcripts.

MOBILE.TITLE: Mobile
MOBILE.L1: Tap targets large enough and well spaced.
MOBILE.L2: Consistent navigation with TalkBack (Android) and VoiceOver (iOS).

NONACCESSIBLE.TITLE: Non-accessible content (observed or potential)
NONACCESSIBLE.TEXT: Despite our efforts, some elements may remain non-compliant:
NONACCESSIBLE.L1: Legacy images without descriptive alternative text.
NONACCESSIBLE.L2: Third-party documents (PDFs, attachments) not fully accessible.
NONACCESSIBLE.L4: Embedded third-party components (payments, maps, players) with their own limitations.
NONACCESSIBLE.MOTIVES: Possible reasons: third-party content, disproportionate burden, ongoing updates.

ACCOMMODATIONS.TITLE: Alternatives and reasonable accommodations
ACCOMMODATIONS.TEXT: If you need an alternative format (e.g., an accessible document, booking assistance), contact us. We will do our best to provide an equivalent solution.

FEEDBACK.TITLE: Feedback and assistance
FEEDBACK.L3: Please specify the screen/URL, device, browser, and, if applicable, the screen reader used.

RECOURSE.TITLE: Escalation procedure (France)
RECOURSE.TEXT: If you notice an accessibility issue preventing access to content or a feature, and you cannot obtain a satisfactory response from us, you may:
RECOURSE.L1: Write to the Défenseur des droits or their local representative in your department,
RECOURSE.L2: Or contact the mediator where applicable.

CONTINUOUS.TITLE: Continuous improvement
CONTINUOUS.L2: Code review and accessibility testing for every release.
CONTINUOUS.L3: Regular training for product and support teams.
CONTINUOUS.L4: Fixes prioritized based on user impact.

DATE.TITLE: Statement date and updates
DATE.TEXT: Statement issued on December 25, 2025. It will be updated at least once a year or after major changes.

HELP.QUESTION10: How do I contact the izyGlam team?
HELP.QUESTION11: How does the cancellation and refund policy work?
HELP.QUESTION12: Can I book for someone else (gift, surprise)?
HELP.QUESTION13: How do I become a partner professional on izyGlam?
HELP.QUESTION14: How do I protect my personal information on izyGlam?
HELP.REPONSE1: It’s simple and fast. Once you’ve signed up, choose the service you’re interested in, discover available professionals near you, then pick a date and time. Click “Book” to finalize, and pay by credit/debit card. Your booking will then be manually confirmed by the professional. If they refuse, you’ll be fully refunded.
HELP.REPONSE2: Each professional has a detailed profile with their services, prices, portfolio photos, and customer reviews. You can also add favorites to find them easily later. Take a moment to compare profiles to choose the one that best matches your needs.
HELP.REPONSE3: You can edit or cancel your booking from your personal area. Cancellations are free up to 24 hours before the service. After that, fees may apply. If you run into any issues, our support team is here to help.
HELP.REPONSE4: Log in to your personal area and go to “My bookings”. You’ll find real-time tracking of your order, the option to cancel or modify it, and your service history.
HELP.REPONSE5: Payment is made exclusively by bank card (Visa, MasterCard, American Express). We don’t offer cash payments or PayPal. Everything is secured to ensure your peace of mind.
HELP.REPONSE6: Once your booking is confirmed, you’ll receive a recap email. We’ll also send you a reminder before the service (by email and/or push notification). You can also track your status from your personal area.
HELP.REPONSE7: Yes. After each completed service, you’ll be invited to leave a review for the professional. Reviews are manually moderated to ensure authenticity. Professionals can’t reply to or edit reviews.
HELP.REPONSE8: For now, izyGlam doesn’t offer a loyalty program or promo codes yet. These features are planned for a later phase.
HELP.REPONSE9: You can contact us directly from the “Contact” section or by email. Our team will do its best to reply within 24 hours (indicative timeframe) and help you resolve the issue as quickly as possible.
HELP.REPONSE10: You can reach us via the contact form on the website or the app. Customer support is available Monday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm. Example email: support@izyglam.com
HELP.REPONSE11: You can cancel your booking free of charge up to 24 hours before the scheduled time. After that, fees may apply. If your booking is refused by the professional, the refund is automatic. The automatic refund system is currently being rolled out.
HELP.REPONSE12: You can’t yet gift a service to someone else directly from your account. However, if a professional offers a duo or family package, you can book for multiple people within that specific offer.
HELP.REPONSE13: Are you an esthetician, hairdresser, or wellness practitioner? You can join the izyGlam community by filling out the form on the “Become a partner” page. Our team will get back to you quickly to finalize your registration.
HELP.REPONSE14: Your data security is our priority. We comply with GDPR requirements. Only the information strictly necessary for the service is accessible to professionals. An in-app messaging feature allows you to communicate if needed, but any attempt to bypass the platform will be monitored.

WHO.TITLE: Who are we?
WHO.TEXT: This Privacy Policy explains how izyGlam (hereinafter “we”, “our”, or “the Platform”) collects, uses, stores, shares, and protects your personal data when you use our services (website, web app, mobile app, emails, and support). We act as the data controller for the processing activities described below.

SCOPE.TITLE: Scope of this policy
SCOPE.TEXT: This policy applies to customers who book services, professionals who offer services via izyGlam, and visitors to our interfaces.

PROVIDED.TITLE: Data you provide
PROVIDED.L1: Identity & contact: first name, last name, email, phone number, address(es), photo/avatars.
PROVIDED.L3: Bookings: selected services, date/time, service address(es), notes, attachments.
PROVIDED.L4: Payment: payment information via our payment provider (e.g., Stripe); we do not store your card details.
PROVIDED.L5: Professionals: public profile, services, prices, service areas, availability, bank details/IBAN (secured), verification documents if required.
PROVIDED.L6: Support: messages, tickets, call recordings where applicable.

AUTOMATIC.TITLE: Data collected automatically
AUTOMATIC.L1: Technical data: device model, OS, browser, screen resolution, session identifiers.
AUTOMATIC.L2: Logging: IP addresses, timestamps, error events, feature usage.
AUTOMATIC.L3: Location: approximate (IP) or precise (GPS, with your explicit consent).
AUTOMATIC.L4: Cookies & SDKs: see the dedicated section below.

PURPOSES.TITLE: Purposes & legal bases
PURPOSES.TEXT: We process data for the following purposes:
PURPOSES.L1: Provide the service (account creation, booking, matching, notifications). Basis: performance of a contract.
PURPOSES.L6: Direct marketing (emails/app) — Consent when required; opt-out available at any time.

SHARING.TITLE: Data sharing
SHARING.L1: Professionals / Customers: information necessary to perform the service (name, contact method, service address, booking details).
SHARING.L2: Service providers: payment (e.g., Stripe), hosting/storage, analytics, email/SMS push, support, KYC where applicable. Access limited to what is necessary, GDPR-compliant agreements.
SHARING.L3: Partners: if you consent to specific offers.
SHARING.L4: Authorities: when required by law or to defend our rights.

TRANSFERS.TITLE: Transfers outside the EU/EEA
TRANSFERS.TEXT: When data is transferred to countries without an adequacy decision, we use Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and implement additional safeguards.

RETENTION.TITLE: Data retention periods
RETENTION.L1: Account & identity: during account use, then up to 3 years after last activity (prospecting) or 5 to 10 years for accounting/legal obligations.
RETENTION.L3: Security logs: 6 to 24 months depending on criticality.
RETENTION.NOTE: After that, data is deleted or anonymized.

COOKIES.TITLE: Cookies & SDKs
COOKIES.TEXT: We use cookies/SDKs to operate the Platform, measure audience, prevent fraud, and—subject to your consent—personalize the experience.
COOKIES.PREF: You can manage your preferences at any time via the banner and your browser settings.

AUTOMATION.TITLE: Automated decisions & profiling
AUTOMATION.TEXT: We may use automated signals (e.g., fraud risk, pro availability, distance) to prioritize actions or propose time slots. No decision producing significant legal effects is made without human intervention, unless required by law or with your explicit consent.

RIGHTS.TITLE: Your rights (GDPR)
RIGHTS.L3: Right to object to processing based on legitimate interest.
RIGHTS.L4: Right to withdraw consent at any time.
RIGHTS.L5: Right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL.

SECURITY.TITLE: Security
SECURITY.TEXT: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures: encryption in transit (TLS), password hashing, logging and monitoring, access control, backups, code review, and security testing.

MINORS.TITLE: Minors’ data
MINORS.TEXT: Our services are not intended for individuals under 15. If a minor account is identified, we will delete it after verification.

DEFINITIONS.TITLE: Definitions
DEFINITIONS.L1: Customer: any person who books and/or pays for a service on the Platform.
DEFINITIONS.L2: Professional: any person who offers services via the Platform.
DEFINITIONS.L3: Service: a service offered by a Professional (e.g., at-home beauty).
DEFINITIONS.L4: Platform: the software infrastructure, websites, and applications operated by izyGlam.

SERVICE_ROLE.TITLE: Services and izyGlam’s role
SERVICE_ROLE.TEXT: izyGlam is a matching platform. Professionals are solely responsible for the services they provide (quality, compliance, insurance). Unless stated otherwise, izyGlam is neither the seller nor the provider of these services and does not assume responsibility for execution.

ACCOUNT.TITLE: Account and eligibility
ACCOUNT.L1: Registration is required to book or offer a service. You agree to provide accurate information and keep it up to date.
ACCOUNT.L2: You must be at least 15 years old to use the Platform. Professionals must be legally authorized to practice.
ACCOUNT.L3: You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for any activity carried out through your account.
ACCOUNT.L4: izyGlam reserves the right to suspend or terminate an account in case of ToU violation or proven risk of fraud.

BOOKINGS.TITLE: Bookings and contract formation
BOOKINGS.L1: Services are booked and paid online by the Customer. No cash is due on site.
BOOKINGS.L2: The booking is subject to confirmation by the Professional after payment. If refused, the Customer is fully refunded.
BOOKINGS.L3: The service contract is concluded directly between the Customer and the Professional at the time of acceptance.
BOOKINGS.L4: Schedules, service addresses, and any special conditions must be checked by the parties.

PRICES_PAYMENTS.TITLE: Prices, subscriptions, and payments
PRICES_PAYMENTS.L1: Service prices are set freely by Professionals. izyGlam applies a platform commission.
PRICES_PAYMENTS.L2: Professional subscriptions (current example): 1 salon free for life; Basic: 3 salons – €99/month; Premium: 10 salons – €499/month; beyond: custom quote.
PRICES_PAYMENTS.L3: Payment by bank card only via a provider (e.g., Stripe). No cash, no promo codes, no loyalty program at this stage.
PRICES_PAYMENTS.L4: Applicable amounts, taxes, and fees are shown before confirmation. Subscription terms may evolve; changes will be communicated in advance.

CANCELLATIONS.TITLE: Cancellation, refunds, and no-shows
CANCELLATIONS.L1: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the scheduled service time.
CANCELLATIONS.L2: Within 24 hours, fees may apply according to the policy in force.
CANCELLATIONS.L3: If the Professional refuses after payment, the Customer is refunded 100%. Refund automation is being rolled out; if needed, support will initiate the operation.
CANCELLATIONS.L4: No-shows (unreported absence) may result in fees or ineligibility for a refund.

PAYOUTS.TITLE: Payouts to Professionals
PAYOUTS.L1: Payout to the Professional is triggered upon confirmation that the service was performed (e.g., validation code confirmation).
PAYOUTS.L2: The bank details/IBAN provided by the Professional are used for the transfer. The Professional guarantees their banking information is accurate.
PAYOUTS.L3: Amounts paid correspond to the service price minus commission and applicable fees.

RESPONSIBILITIES.TITLE: Responsibilities of the parties
RESPONSIBILITIES.L1: Professionals ensure their services comply with regulations and meet hygiene and safety requirements.
RESPONSIBILITIES.L2: Customers agree to provide accurate information (address, availability, access constraints) and to keep appointments.
RESPONSIBILITIES.L3: izyGlam provides the Platform and tools (booking, payments, messaging) but does not guarantee service outcomes.

REVIEWS.TITLE: Reviews and ratings
REVIEWS.L1: Reviews can be left only after a service has actually been performed.
REVIEWS.L2: Reviews may be subject to moderation (e.g., removal of content contrary to law or these ToU).

PROHIBITED.L1: Fraud, identity theft, bypassing the Platform, encouraging off-platform transactions.
PROHIBITED.L2: Illegal, defamatory, discriminatory, violent, or immoral content.
